verdicts.note: The paper identifies ~1,400 K as the transition onset at 26 GPa, not as a general maximum heating temperature at all three pressure points.
~1,400 K is reported specifically at 26 GPa; temperatures reached at 6 and 14 GPa are not stated in the provided text. NaCl is identified as a pressure medium, but not explicitly as hydrostatic.

The thermodynamic and kinetic interpretation is supported, but the paper does not establish stacking faults as the definitive transition mechanism; it says the mechanism may be more complex and involve stacking faults, dislocations, twinning, magnetic states, and volume.
